overview: This batch finalizes the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick-based physics integration for ultra-endgame stability, and compressing colonist psychological states into a bit-packed format to reduce memory footprint during long-running simulations.

tasks.title: Implement Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::hash with a custom FNV-1a implementation for 64-bit integers. Iterate through all active subsystems (Physics, AI, Graphics) in a fixed order. Combine hashes using XOR and rotation. Ensure no floating-point non-determinism by using fixed-point arithmetic for hash inputs. Zero heap allocations during hashing.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Hash value is identical across 1000 consecutive runs with same seed. 2. Hash computation completes in <1ms for 5,500 ticks. 3. No memory leaks detected.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures reliable save/load functionality, preventing progress loss in long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Tick-Based Physics Integration for Ultra-Endgame Stability
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a semi-implicit Euler integrator with fixed timestep. Use a circular buffer for position/velocity history to enable interpolation without heap allocation. Clamp maximum velocity to prevent numerical explosion. Ensure all calculations use double precision for intermediate steps but store as float for memory efficiency.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Position drift < 1e-6 over 10,000 ticks. 2. No NaN values in position/velocity arrays. 3. Integration step completes in <0.5ms.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Provides smooth and stable physics behavior, enhancing visual fidelity and interaction responsiveness.

tasks.title: Compress Colonist Psychological States into Bit-Packed Format
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a struct with bit-fields for mood, hunger, and energy levels. Use std::bit_cast for efficient serialization. Implement a compact decoder that unpacks these fields into a standard struct for AI logic. Ensure all operations are constexpr where possible.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Memory usage reduced by 50% compared to previous format. 2. Decode/encode operations complete in <0.1ms. 3. No data loss during compression/decompression.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Improves performance and reduces memory usage, allowing for larger and more complex simulations.
